# The pendulum: a hub at the pivot, a rod behind the coin plane, a brass bob in it (r 0.36).
# Origin at the pivot; the game swings it (roll). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Rod --base-color 0.549 0.247 0.365 --no-slot
material new Bob --base-color 0.949 0.651 0.369 --no-slot
material new Hub --base-color 0.922 0.337 0.294 --no-slot
material new Face --base-color 1.000 0.894 0.471 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Rod --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.1100 -0.9250
scale 0.1200 0.1000 1.8500
apply --scale
material assign Rod
add mesh cylinder --name Hub --vertices 8 --radius 0.2000 --depth 0.2200 --location 0.0000 -0.0200 0.0000 --rotation 90 22.50 0
material assign Hub
add mesh cylinder --name Bob --vertices 12 --radius 0.3600 --depth 0.1800 --location 0.0000 0.0000 -1.8500 --rotation 90 15.00 0
material assign Bob
add mesh cylinder --name Boss --vertices 8 --radius 0.1700 --depth 0.1000 --location 0.0000 -0.1300 -1.8500 --rotation 90 22.50 0
material assign Face
select all
shade flat
export pendulum.glb
